subject: history
title: Year 7 History Section C Sentence Builder
description: Tiffin-style Section C argumentative essay practice with visual comics, evidence recall MCQs and sentence builders.

data.prompt: Build the corroborate point for Walsham division.
data.answer: The Black Death divided Walsham because fear, wealth and survival choices separated villagers.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic showing how the Black Death both united and divided Walsham.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: the Black Death created moments of shared faith and fear, but also exposed divisions over wealth, flight and wages.

data.prompt: Build the counter point for Walsham unity.
data.answer: The Black Death also united Walsham because shared fear encouraged prayer, pilgrimage and collective protection.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic showing how the Black Death both united and divided Walsham.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: the Black Death created moments of shared faith and fear, but also exposed divisions over wealth, flight and wages.

data.prompt: Build the clincher judgement for Walsham.
data.answer: The Black Death created moments of unity, but it divided Walsham more deeply through fear, inequality and labour conflict.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic showing how the Black Death both united and divided Walsham.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: the Black Death created moments of shared faith and fear, but also exposed divisions over wealth, flight and wages.

data.prompt: Build the corroborate point for Athelstan.
data.answer: Military conquest was crucial because Athelstan captured York in 927 and defeated rivals.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic showing Athelstan using conquest, law, Christianity and kingship.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: conquest gave Athelstan power, while law, titles and Christian kingship helped make that power recognised.

data.prompt: Build the counter point for Athelstan.
data.answer: Athelstan also needed coronation, law, councils and Christian kingship to make his rule legitimate.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic showing Athelstan using conquest, law, Christianity and kingship.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: conquest gave Athelstan power, while law, titles and Christian kingship helped make that power recognised.

data.prompt: Build the clincher judgement for Athelstan.
data.answer: Conquest gave Athelstan power, but politics, law and religion helped turn that power into kingship.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic showing Athelstan using conquest, law, Christianity and kingship.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: conquest gave Athelstan power, while law, titles and Christian kingship helped make that power recognised.

data.prompt: Build the corroborate point for algebra.
data.answer: Algebra was highly significant because Al-Khwarizmi’s Al-Jabr influenced mathematics, science and computing for centuries.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic comparing algebra and medicine in the Islamic Golden Age.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: algebra had wide long-term influence, while medicine had immediate practical importance for human life.

data.prompt: Build the counter point for medicine.
data.answer: Medicine was also significant because scholars such as Al-Razi and Al-Zahrawi improved diagnosis, treatment and surgery.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic comparing algebra and medicine in the Islamic Golden Age.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: algebra had wide long-term influence, while medicine had immediate practical importance for human life.

data.prompt: Build the clincher judgement for algebra and medicine.
data.answer: Algebra had the wider long-term intellectual impact, but medicine was equally important for practical health and human life.
data.imageAlt: Six-panel comic comparing algebra and medicine in the Islamic Golden Age.
data.imageCaption: Visual argument: algebra had wide long-term influence, while medicine had immediate practical importance for human life.
